import sys, lzma
F=[{"id":lzma.FILTER_LZMA2,"preset":9|lzma.PRESET_EXTREME,"dict_size":1<<23,"lc":4,"lp":0,"pb":0,"nice_len":273,"mf":lzma.MF_BT4}]
d=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
if sys.argv[1]=="c":
    o=lzma.compress(d,format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW,filters=F)
else:
    o=lzma.decompress(d,format=lzma.FORMAT_RAW,filters=F)
sys.stdout.buffer.write(o)
